name: vcpeer-book-platform
description: VCPeer Book Platform API — standalone Node/Express service providing self-serve signup, booking-funnel analytics, webhook-driven notifications, billing/feature-flags, custom-domain provisioning, a public REST API, and an embeddable booking widget in front of the self-hosted Cal.com (cal.diy) instance at book.vcpeer.com. Talks to Cal.com only over HTTP and via its own Postgres schema ('platform') in the same database — no Cal.com source is forked or edited.
